text: Ghulam Nabi Wani Sogami (O2 January 1916 – 23 July 1981) was an Indian politician from the erstwhile state of Jammu and Kashmir. He was the grandfather of Nasir Aslam Wani and was born in Sogam Lolab. Wani served as a Member of the Legislative Assembly (MLA) representing the Lolab Valley constituency in the Kupwara district from 1951 to 1977. He held ministerial positions in Bakshi Ghulam Mohammad's Cabinet, specifically serving as Cabinet Minister for Forests, Industries & Commerce, and Rural Development. He passed away in the Rajbagh neighborhood of Srinagar, India on 23 July 1981. This article about an Indian National Congress politician from Jammu and Kashmir is a stub.
